venues.name: Buckhead Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our box office is only open on show days beginning at noon.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept American Express, Discover, Mastercard, and VISA cards (debit or credit). Must have an ID that matches the name on the card. We cannot accept cash at this time.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call can be picked up from the box office window by the front entrance starting at noon on the day of show. Please bring a photo ID that matches the name on the account. Please note that will call for artist guest list is not typically available until doors open or later.

venues.parkingDetail: The Buckhead Theatre does not currently own or operate any parking lots. Paid parking lots and parking decks are located within a short walking distance of the theatre. Rates generally range from $10-$30. Additionally, Buckhead Theatre has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer other easy and reliable options. Please visit https://www.parkwhiz.com/buckhead-theatre-parking?pwa=pa1269&utm_medium=LiveNation&utm_source=1269&utm_campaign=Web_LN_ParkingPage_VenueLink to book parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: o Yes. For shows with a general admission floor, we have a designated area for patrons with special needs and one companion. A specific ticket is not required to access this area. For reserved seated shows, guests with ADA needs can purchase tickets online or at the box office. The designated seats will show online with the ADA symbol.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website www.thebuckheadtheatre.com
generalInfo.childRule: o Most of our events are all ages; however, some shows may be restricted to certain ages. Please check "More Info" on the particular event for any age restrictions specific to the event. All patrons over the age of 3 require a ticket.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Our box office is open on show days only starting 2 hours prior to general door time. *This is subject to change.*
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Coca-Cola Roxy is a cashless venue inside. We accept all major credit cards including VISA, Mastercard, Amex, & Discover. Apple Pay & Google Pay are also accepted.

venues.parkingDetail: The Coca-Cola Roxy offers parking for events when there is NOT an Atlanta Braves home game or Truist Park concert/event. We offer parking to two parking decks, Orange Valet Deck(800 Battery Ave) and Delta Deck(655 Battery Ave). Please visit www.cocacolaroxy.com to see what events will offer parking. If there is a home game/event at Truist Park, please visit www.mlb.com/braves/ballpark/transportation/parking to purchase parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Coca-Cola Roxy strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to everyone. For all information about accessibility at our venue, including: arrival & accessible entrances, accessible restrooms, ticketing, accessible parking, medication & dietary needs, service animals , sign language interpretation, assistive listening devices, & mobility device storage - please visit cocacolaroxy.com/accessibility. For more questions, or information not mentioned in our FAQ, please contact us at cocacolaroxyinfo@livenation.com.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website www.cocacolaroxy.com
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons must have a ticket regardless of age. Some shows may be restricted to certain ages. Please check our website www.cocacolaroxy.com for updated information.
